paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Ziron, son of Rabbi Meir’s father-in-law—see his entry—testified before Rabbi that Rabbi Meir ate a vegetable leaf: Chullin 6b. In Shabbat 147a: Ziruz, who spoke to Rabbi; and in the chapter Tolin. In the Jerusalem Talmud, Demai 2:1: Yehoshua ben Ziruz.
